apps.localizedDescription:
Orbit for iPhone:

The phone app for Orbit, your own AI workspace on your Mac. Orbit runs any model through the real Claude Code or Codex agent, lets chats hand work to each other, keeps going toward a goal, and queues or schedules messages. Your chats, files and the model that answers all stay on the Mac. This app is a live window onto them, from any network with no VPN (through your own Cloudflare Tunnel), over Tailscale, or over your Wi-Fi at home. It also carries the Mac's cluster, Crew, helper and shared-project screens.

• Approvals from the Lock Screen. Allow or Deny a step on the notification itself, without opening the app.

versions.localizedDescription:
Orbit for iPhone 1.2.

• Several accounts. Settings → Models & keys: add Claude accounts (each signed in with its own token), choose the main one, test, rename, remove. The same page has two switches for when an account runs out: move to the next by itself, and go back to the main one once its limit has reset. These apply to OpenCode Go accounts too.
